threads.body: Bedrock Runtime exposes the response `contentType` field from the required `X-Amzn-Bedrock-Content-Type` header; Flask's standard `Content-Type` header does not populate that SDK field. Add `x-amzn-bedrock-content-type: application/json` here so the new InvokeModel response matches the service contract.

InvokeModelWithResponseStream also requires `X-Amzn-Bedrock-Content-Type` to expose the model payload MIME type (`application/json`) separately from the EventStream transport MIME type. Without it, SDK responses omit the modeled `contentType` field.

Base this decision on the active turn/result pairing rather than the global `called_names` set, with a regression test for calling the same tool again.

Normalize null to an empty list before iterating.
